protocol.sampling: NumPy default_rng(seed); draw speed, approval, deck front, absolute pier X independently
protocol.inspection_rule: Translate fixed seed-0 inspection region by deck-front displacement
protocol.calibration_rule: Single draw; nominal unsafe, D=0 safe inspection, immediate sideways safe
protocol.climb: Immediate diagnostic only; never affects acceptance

provenance.raw_trajectory_coordinate_frame: PyBullet world Z-up; N=x_world, E=-y_world, D=-z_world
provenance.scientific_assumptions: All new geometry, maneuver and inspection parameters are provisional pilot assumptions.
provenance.command_semantics: Measured initiation position plus fixed scenario displacement; no replanning.
provenance.reference_smoothness: C2 internal joins; actual-position reanchoring at dispatch retains measured nominal tracking mismatch.
provenance.safety: signed Euclidean point-to-box distance minus body radius >= clearance_m
provenance.inspection: Inclusive fixed XYZ bounds, elapsed continuous dwell; safe_completion also requires whole-flight safety.
provenance.monitoring: From reset through approval + observation_s, even after violation or completion.
